review_comment: User-provided gcov-args are HTML escaped but then directly concatenated into a shell command. This allows command injection as HTML escaping does not protect against shell metacharacters. The fix should use proper shell escaping or parameterization of the command arguments.

The gcov-exec argument from CLI is used in shell command construction without proper shell escaping. The validator.escape() function only handles HTML characters, not shell metacharacters. This allows command injection where attackers can execute arbitrary commands on the system. Use shell-specific escaping or parameterized command execution to prevent this vulnerability.
